title: The Evening Brief: Market in Extreme Fear as Major Coins Sink on Thin Sunday News
dek: Crypto markets sit at the depths of fear with Bitcoin and altcoins pinned near year-long lows, while the desk's boards show heavy long liquidations and a sharp deceleration in outflows from exchanges.
author: GoCheckMyCrypto
key_fact: The desk's leverage board shows $1.03 billion in long liquidations across Bitcoin and Ether in the past two hours alone, while Bitcoin outflows from exchanges have slowed to $404 million for the week of November 21, down sharply from $1.55 billion the prior week.
bottom_line: Crypto markets sit at the depths of extreme fear, with Bitcoin and altcoins trading 50-80% below annual highs and RSI14 readings below 30 across majors. Per the desk's leverage board, $1 billion in long liquidations crossed OKX in just two hours, while spot ETF outflows accelerated to $1.25 billion over the week through November 20. The desk's Whale Watch board shows outflow momentum has slowed sharply, from $4.1 billion to just $404 million week-over-week, and stablecoins have flowed onto exchanges in heavy volume ($494 million net in the past week), signaling potential capitulation-stage cash-outs. The desk will watch for Kalshi's court appearance Monday and any fallout from the Chainflip theft disclosure, which carries a November 24 bounty deadline.
body: Crypto sentiment has collapsed into extreme fear on Sunday evening. The desk's Fear and Greed Index stands at 11, the lowest reading in 30 days, as major coins trade deep underwater from their annual highs. Bitcoin sits 51.3% below its 12-month peak of $124,739.81, while Ethereum is down 63.5% from $4,690.84, and Solana has fallen 69.8% from $232.63. Across the board, RSI14 readings sit below 30, signaling oversold technicals: Bitcoin's RSI14 is 25.3, Ether's is 29.1, and XRP's is 17.1, the lowest of the major assets.

The tape reveals acute stress in leveraged positions. Bitcoin's funding rate on OKX stands at 0.0023% per 8-hour interval, annualizing to 2.5%, a calm level, but the long-to-short ratio of 2.2 on Bitcoin indicates heavy long positioning ahead of these liquidations. Bitcoin up 1.03% over 24 hours, Bitcoin down 6.24% over seven days, and Bitcoin down 26.08% over thirty days show the intraday bounce has not reversed the week or month's direction.

Spot ETF flows have reversed sharply. After four days of net inflows, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows of $124.5M on the day, November 20, and net outflows of $1,245.3M over the week through November 20. The desk's Whale Watch board shows a wider pattern: net value moving off exchanges has decelerated, $4.13 billion left exchanges in the week ending November 7, $1.55 billion in the week ending November 14, but only $404 million in the week ending November 21. Within that, $488.88 million in bitcoin moved off exchanges while $177.6 million in ethereum moved onto exchanges over the past 168 hours, a mix that suggests sellers are stepping in.

The desk has no published stories today. No major news wire items directly move the tape this Sunday evening; the desk's wire notes three items in live custody, the Chainflip theft disclosure, the Kalshi court date Monday, and the Cyber bridge exploit at Upbit and Bithumb, but none have published reporting from this desk tied to today's close.
